invariants: live comments are classified once as user, agent, or ai and retain their original source
the live comment round trip retains every rendered annotation field
stored reviewer notes retain edit authority and use deterministic author and timestamp defaults
draft create, edit, and reply modes retain their target identities and derive side-specific ranges
grouping preserves stored order and omits missing files and orphaned anchors
threaded grouping preserves raw reply detection plus visible depth and sibling guides

nativeAdaptation.renderer: Ratatui consumes a flat TerminalReviewNote projection instead of a React annotation object.
nativeAdaptation.fileIdentity: The terminal key is DiffFile.runtime_id; semantic storage remains keyed by DiffFile.key.
nativeAdaptation.coverage: Seven Rust tests translate all six upstream tests and add the baseline threaded-helper case.
